narration: You do not turn failure into another body. From the courtyard you score the trapped stall’s position into the hitching post and beat the district fire-call on its iron ring. Bucket runners answer from two streets. You lead them only to the safe edge, tell them exactly where the roof fell, then take the muddy west passage back. The belfry is still ringing; the office can no longer pretend nobody saw.
